_comment: Hand-computed validation findings per fixture, keyed by fixture filename. rowId = 'row-N' (1-indexed data row, header excluded). Consumed by frontend/tests/csvInjection.test.ts and backend/tests/test_formula_injection.py / test_ambiguous_phone.py.

ambiguous_phones.csv.note: None of these phones carry an explicit leading '+<countrycode>', so every row must be flagged ambiguous and none may have a guessed country code applied.

formula_injection.csv.note: Leading characters '=', '+', '-', '@' on any cell trigger formula_injection_risk per OWASP CSV-injection guidance. On export these cells must be re-emitted with a leading single-quote, value otherwise unchanged.
